# Deel
> Deel is a global HR and payroll platform that lets companies hire employees and contractors in 150+ countries without setting up local entities. It combines payroll, HR, IT, compliance, and benefits into one platform.

Deel serves 35,000+ customers from startups to enterprises like Shopify, Nike, and Klarna. Common use cases include hiring internationally via Employer of Record (EOR), running multi-country payroll, managing distributed teams, and staying compliant with local labor laws. Unlike aggregators, Deel owns its payroll infrastructure and operates legal entities in 100+ countries directly. The platform is SOC 2 Type II certified, ISO 27001 compliant, and GDPR compliant.

Typical audiences: HR leaders evaluating global hiring solutions, finance teams comparing payroll providers, legal teams assessing compliance risk, and IT teams managing distributed device fleets.

For a complete index of all content on deel.com (4,000+ pages), see [llms-full.txt](https://www.deel.com/llms-full.txt).
